notes.title: Warp Factor: Engage update released!
notes.content:
The Warp Factor: Engage update has now landed and its long list of features is sure to make your gaming experience that much more insane!

Here's some of the major changes:
[list]
[*]New enemies, blocks and level features
[*]5 new levels
[*]A level editor
[*]Updated textures and effects
[/list]

[previewyoutube=nO3T2f-KKOM;full][/previewyoutube]

The update also includes mouse support, a colour blind mode and the ability to share your levels with friends in online multiplayer.

[b][i]So prepare to engage the warp drive and jump to lightspeed with the Warp Factor: Engage update, good luck Captain![/i][/b]
